cwd.description: Folder holding CMakePresets.json, relative to the workspace root, every invocation runs in it

configure.description: The cmake invocation that configures the build tree of the packaging workflow

build.description: The cmake --build invocation of the project's targets in that tree

pack.description: The cpack invocation naming the package preset and the CPack configuration file of the project, without a package directory

outputPath.description: Folder, relative to the workspace root, receiving the package files alone

args.description: Arguments appended to the cpack invocation

title: Package
description: Configures the packaging workflow's build tree, builds the project's targets from its manifest as it stands, and packs the project's install tree with CPack into a staging folder, then replaces the output folder with the package files CPack named from the project name, version, system, and processor
